name: Balbach Teaching Dimension of Singletons plus Empty Set
proof: Every singleton has a one-point positive teaching set. For the empty concept, one negative example still leaves singleton hypotheses whose ordinary teaching-set size is one, so the size filter does not isolate it; any two negative examples do. Thus the stabilized Balbach maximum is two (and the source notes the separate degenerate $n=1$ case has value one).
